_doc: Targets of the jump table of irq0_handler in the listing of run H (logs/H.image.lst of experiments/exp23, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0). A listing has no .rodata: the targets come from the code of the cases. +0x58 (0x40000eb8): k <<= 1 and the loop test, the target of case 0; +0x84 (0x40000ee4): case MASK_S0CAUSE_TIMER (reads TIMERCAUSE at 0xe1020400), taken once per call (k = 4). The same listing serves run G (G.image.lst equals H.image.lst except the F_CPU constants).
